known.via: English Wikipedia "Mendocino County AVA" (redirects to "Mendocino County wine")

notes: The warm inland part of the county makes full bodied, very ripe reds from Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Petite Sirah and Zinfandel.

blurb.text: A county appellation for wine from grapes grown mostly in Mendocino County, with two climate zones: a cool coastal west and an inland area mostly beyond the ocean's reach.
